parts.note: Right body and main deadlines, but missed Stage 1/5-working-day early resolution and used the wrong complaint-form URL.
Right ombudsman and 12-month rule, but it missed the live SPSO outage/technical banner, 9-month allocation delay, and the legal-action sequencing point.

Correct that compensation is by civil damages, but framed the body as SCTS, and missed key Scottish specifics: no NHS redress scheme, sheriff/Court of Session split, no clinical-negligence pre-action protocol, and CLO/CNORIS.
Correct that Scottish legal aid is available and success fees are capped, but it omitted QOCS and most eligibility detail.
Right directory, but it missed the important need to avoid 'defender only' medical-negligence specialists and did not use the verified SLAB finder as a fallback.
Right Scottish guideline body, but it missed the key nuance that there is no SIGN scaphoid guideline and NICE NG38 is the practical reference.
PASS was identified correctly with the right support role and contact routes.
Right NHS Lothian SAR route and portal, but it omitted the 30-day/free-of-charge point, ID requirements, and did not mention duty of candour.

smart: It correctly spotted a Scotland-specific strength many agents miss: civil legal aid is available for medical negligence, alongside capped Scottish success-fee agreements.
worst: It missed major live-route realities: the NHS Lothian complaint form link was wrong, and the SPSO step omitted the current outage and 9-month allocation delay.
